label: Test by Successor model for the strict-ground map at the efficient-cause consumer
note: Tests the selected premise in the following setting. Nat, Unit, D(x,y) iff x < y; E(c,x,()) and C(c,x) iff c = x+1; P(c,x) iff x < c. The atoms are labels. strictGroundConsumerAllowsInfiniteCauses; every f has cause f+1 even though each cause is independent of its effect. The certificate provides both PLG consistency and the distinct-edge map under the identity labelling, together with the cause-independence consumer on that same interpretation.
